title: DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Cecile Grondin
materials: - Add 10 μl of RNase (100 mg/ml, Qiagen ref: 19101). Incubate for 60 min at 37 °C.
- Set up the tubes on the magnetic rack (DynaMag™-2 Magnet type, Invitrogen ThermoFisher Scientific).
- Wait for 2 min. Remove the liquid.
- The DNAs are then stored at -20°C.

steps.title: Grow yeast culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 3 ml YPD medium (yeast extract 10 g/L, bacto peptone 10 g/L, glucose 10 g/L) and incubate for 60 h to reach stationary phase.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture for 5 min at 5000 rpm and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 5 ml 50 mM EDTA, transfer to a 2 ml screw‑cap tube, centrifuge 5 min at 12000 rpm and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells with reagents
steps.instruction: Add 0.2 ml lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 8, 50 mM EDTA, 100 mM NaCl, 2 % Triton, 1 % SDS), 0.2 ml TE 1X (10 mM Tris pH 8, 1 mM EDTA), 0.2 ml phenol/chloroform and 0.3 g glass beads to the pellet.

steps.title: Disrupt cells with bead beater
steps.instruction: Grind the mixture with a Digital Disruptor Genie (Scientific Industries, Bohemia, NY 11716, USA) for 2 min at 2850 rpm.

steps.title: Extract aqueous phase with chloroform
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube, add 0.5 ml chloroform and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube, add 0.5 ml isopropanol and mix.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the resulting DNA pellet with 0.4 ml 70 % ethanol and allow the tube to dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA overnight
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried DNA pellet in 490 µL TE 1X and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bind DNA to magnetic beads
steps.instruction: To each sample add 50 µL 5 M NaCl, 15 µL Chemagic CMG‑252‑A magnetic bead suspension (PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA), 250 µL 7.8 M Guanidine chloride and 800 µL isopropanol; mix to allow binding.

steps.title: First magnetic bead wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml AMMLAV/E buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA, 60 mM potassium acetate, 65 % ethanol) and mix gently to disintegrate the beads.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack, wait 2 min, then remove the liquid.

steps.title: Ethanol washes of beads
steps.instruction: Perform two successive washes with 1 ml 75 % ethanol each.

substeps.instruction: After each ethanol addition, place tubes on the magnetic rack, allow beads to collect, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Air‑dry magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA and store
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 ml 1X TE, mix well to resuspend the beads, and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on the magnetic rack, wait 5 min, and transfer the cleared DNA solution to new storage tubes.
